prompt: Build a churn prediction model for our subscription business end to end. Data is in the warehouse.
expected_behavior: Starts with Mode A framing questions: the decision, label definition, prediction time, cost of errors, baseline
Builds point-in-time correct features and uses an out-of-time split with a gap for the label window
Runs leakage_check.py and compares against a baseline before any complex model
Stops at the gates to confirm with the user before deployment

prompt: My fraud model gets 0.99 AUC on validation. Can we ship it?
expected_behavior: Chooses Mode F and treats the score as suspicious until leakage is ruled out
Runs leakage_check.py and checks the split against production usage and feature availability at prediction time
Does not recommend shipping before the Leakage and Evaluation gates pass

prompt: We need a weekly sales forecast for each of our 120 stores for the next 8 weeks.
expected_behavior: Uses rolling-origin backtesting with a fixed 8-week horizon and reports error per horizon
Compares against naive and seasonal naive baselines before statistical, ML, or foundation models
Mentions probabilistic forecasts (quantiles) if decisions need them

prompt: Our loan default model's performance dropped over the last two months. Figure out why.
expected_behavior: Checks data pipeline and schema problems before blaming the model
Runs drift_report.py on recent inputs versus training data and model_report.py with slices on matured labels
Mentions fairness and regulatory review because credit decisions affect people

prompt: Put our trained scikit-learn model behind an API and make sure we notice if it goes bad.
expected_behavior: Uses the shared feature function in serving to avoid train-serving skew
Adds input validation, model version in responses, and a prediction log
Sets up drift monitoring, alerts, and a rollback path

prompt: Build a customer support chatbot that answers from our help center articles.
